extracted.name: Mini buns with mayo chicken filled
ingredient_lines: 15 g granulated sugar + 5g more granulated sugar
1 egg for eggwash and sesame seeds to sprinkle on
40 g butter or margarine room temperature
instruction_lines: In a recipient add the liquid milk, the 15g sugar and yeast.. Mix..
Cover and reserve the yeast mixture for 10mins.
Sift the flour, add the left over 5g of sugar, salt. Mix all the dry ingredients before adding the yeast mixture
After 10mins add the yeast mixture in the flour, mix till all combined
Last add butter and mix to form a soft dough. Cover and leave to sit at room temp for 4hrs in a dry warm place.
After 4hrs make small ball out of dough and leave to sit for 1hour more before filling them
After 1hour filled all the buns and reserve for more 1hr30mins before baking
It's time to preheat oven at 180 degrees. Egg wash to be brush on the bun and sprinkle the sesame seeds
Moment awaited.. Baking time.. Once out of oven brush some butter and keep for 15mins before serving.
